Definition: Tubal, a postdiluvian patriarch and his posterity
BiblicalUsage: Tubal is a son of Japheth, and the name of the people and land that came from him. In Genesis 10:2, Tubal, and Meshech. The fuller story is told on the Tubal profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Tubal belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing.
